issues.where: the globe and base across the whole sheet, frames 576-718 (9.60-11.97 s)
issues.what: the shake has no globe motion: the sphere and base hold the identical resting pose in every frame — no lift with effort, no unequal strokes, no reversals, no lagging tilt, no set-down or settle; the storm simply erupts in the glass between 10.03 s (fully calm) and 10.23 s (left half already fogged) while the globe sits dead still, so it reads as an interior effect over a weightless prop, not a heavy thing shaken in a hand
issues.fix: animate the globe itself through the shake: a heavy lift, uneven stroke lengths with sharp reversals and a tilt that lags the hand, then a set-down that lands with a small compress-and-rock settle before the storm peaks

issues.where: the table surface and snow scatter around the base, frames 614-666
issues.what: the surroundings never answer the shake: the snow patches on the table are pixel-identical before, during, and after the supposed lift and landing, and the reflection stays frozen, so the surface contradicts the story that the globe was picked up and slammed down
issues.fix: disturb the loose snow/petals at lift-off and landing (a ring of displaced scatter, a few tossed flakes) and let the reflection and contact shadow translate and tilt with the sphere

issues.where: the interior across the full arrival, 12.00-14.97 s (continuing in set-B-02 through set-B-08)
issues.what: the new season is wiped on, not grown: the spring scene materializes purely as the pink haze thins into a fog fade — the tree, grass and house gain no structure over time, they are already fully formed under the fog and simply rise in opacity
issues.fix: stage the reveal so elements build: branches bud and blossom outward, ground cover spreads from the centre, and particles thin ahead of the geometry instead of a single uniform haze fade

issues.where: the interior glow at frame 666 (11.10 s)
issues.what: the light inside the still-winter globe flips to a peach-pink glow one frame before the fog is fully opaque, telegraphing the swap a beat too early
issues.fix: hold the neutral storm-grey lighting until the fog is fully dense, then let the new season's glow warm the fog from the 11.33 s frame onward
